summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (Release Number CB22-156), dated September 20, 2022, reporting monthly new residential construction statistics for August 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 1a provides the seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) for total privately-owned housing units authorized by building permits, with specific columns for the Northeast and Midwest regions. For the first month of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 window, this document lists the Northeast rate at 139,000 and the Midwest rate at 201,000. As this is the initial report for August 2022 (marked preliminary with "p"), the data serves as the baseline for this month but may be superseded by subsequent revisions in later reports within the collection per task instructions.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release for September 2022 (dated October 19, 2022, Release No. CB22-174). Relevant to the task: Table 1a provides the seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) for total building permits by region, specifically listing values for the Northeast and Midwest for August 2022 and September 2022. For August 2022, the Northeast rate is listed as 138 and Midwest as 202; for September 2022, the Northeast rate is 125 and Midwest is 210. These figures contribute the starting data points for the requested comparison period (August 2022–May 2025) but are marked as revised ('r') and preliminary ('p'), indicating they are subject to update in subsequent reports. Per the task instructions requiring the most recent report to prevail, later releases in the collection may supersede these figures. The document does not contain data for the remainder of the requested timeframe (October 2022 through May 2025).

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (CB22-191) for New Residential Construction in October 2022, dated November 17, 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 1a provides the Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) for total building permits by region (Northeast and Midwest). It supplies data for August, September, and October 2022, which are the first three months of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 window. For these months, the Midwest rate (202, 209, 209 thousand units) is consistently higher than the Northeast rate (138, 129, 120 thousand units). Consequently, this document contributes zero months where the Northeast rate exceeded the Midwest rate for this period, though it covers only the initial months of the required timeframe.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (CB22-210) dated December 20, 2022, reporting monthly new residential construction statistics for November 2022. For these four months, the Midwest SAAR (202, 209, 210, 197 thousand) exceeds the Northeast SAAR (138, 129, 112, 114 thousand) in every instance, indicating the task's condition is not met for this subset.
